theme: An open day in Toronto before the ICGN conference.
greeting: The day is open in Toronto, Dan — a dinner tonight, then the conference begins. Girls are with Jen this week.

needsAttention.title: Shape your Plenary 7 questions
needsAttention.detail: You moderate Plenary 7 on evolving stewardship data Thursday at 3:05; the conference opens tomorrow. The ICGN run-of-show lists your panel — Rachit Gupta, Jane Ambachtsheer and Andy Howard — so an open day now is the time to arrive with your framing and opening questions.

needsAttention.title: The December trip is past its booking window
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board, shortlisting the December-break destination for all four kids (Dec 13 – Jan 2) was due Sept 30 with an Oct 15 booking target — both now passed, and holiday inventory for six only thins from here.

schedule.title: ICGN Board Dinner
schedule.detail: Lee Restaurant — the night before the Autumn Conference opens.

flagged.title: SimplyWise was granted account access
flagged.detail: A Google alert on Nov 2 says the app SimplyWise was granted access to your konigsburg@gmail.com account. Verify it was you, or revoke it.

flagged.title: Amex Pay Over Time change
flagged.detail: Your Amex (ending 3003) switches Pay Over Time to active on Feb 1, 2027. Review your AutoPay setting to avoid interest — not urgent.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts and promos — WSJ, NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, a Maine milkman invoice, eBay/PayPal order confirmations.
inbox.clear: No new mail awaiting your reply, and no job-search or health items.

recipe.title: Mushroom Ragoût
recipe.why: Autumn's mushrooms are at their peak right now — a slow, earthy ragoût to come home to at your own stove after Toronto.

tasks.title: Get three term-life quotes for Mike
Order the Portland bedframe and soap holder

acts.line: A rare clear stretch in Toronto, with nothing on the calendar before the conference days begin.
Still open — good hours for the December-break call or to prep for tomorrow.
The day's one fixed point lands after dark; everything before it is yours to spend.
